description: read the lifecycle record for a registered joseki card: its current state, authoring provenance, knowledge-base path, replacement pointer when superseded, and run evidence (run count and last-run time).
embedding_description: Look up the current lifecycle status of an authored joseki card by key. Returns its state, provenance, stored card path, superseded-by replacement, run count and last-run timestamp. This reads the durable lifecycle row for observability; it does not parse or validate the card markdown and it changes nothing.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Lifecycle row with keys: found, joseki_key, state, provenance, knowledge_base_path, superseded_by, run_count, last_run_at
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: When found is false, say the joseki is not registered. Otherwise report the state and run evidence; mention superseded_by when the card is superseded.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: This is a read for lifecycle observability. Use the returned state to decide the next lifecycle action (promote, record a run, supersede, or archive).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reading the lifecycle row of an authored joseki card. get_authored_joseki accepts {joseki_key} and never mutates state.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A missing card is not an error — the result carries found=false. StorageError: the state read failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Storage failures: retry once the platform reports healthy. For a card that reports found=false, register it first if it should exist.
